content:
julia-pm: Quick readout — Pricing/packaging change planned for next Wed. Need final owners and known blockers. Reply with (1) owner, (2) blocker, (3) ETA. cc @ashley-eng @ben-billing @carmen-legal

ashley-eng: Metering side — schema v2 ready and validated on staging. Ingest pipeline tested (50k events/min). Blocker: billing adapter change (PR #482) needs review + small transform for per-customer cap. ETA: PR ready for review by Tue EOD, merge Wed AM if reviews clear.

ben-billing: Billing update — schema change accepted. Migration strategy: prefer online migration + backfill to avoid downtime. If we choose online, I need signoff by Tue 12:00 to schedule backfill window Wed 02:00-03:00 UTC. Blocker: final migration playbook and runbook. I'll post the plan in the billing doc.

carmen-legal: Contracts — we confirmed wording for grandfathered customers. We need a signed addendum only for customers with explicit legacy clauses. Recommendation: roll out for new/standard contracts immediately; gate grandfathered customers behind manual opt-in. ETA for addendum template: Tue noon. Blocker: customer outreach owners to flag legacy accounts.

metering-bot: [AUTO] Staging metrics snapshot: ingest_rate=48k/min, error_rate=0.08% (mostly transient 503s). Recent trace: trace_id=tr_8f3a, endpoint=/upload, sample_log:
```
ERR 2024-09-12T14:22:01Z upload failed status=503 id=tr_8f3a
```

ashley-eng: noted that 503 spike was due to a short S3 latency window — infra mitigated. Also need to add `customer_cap` field to metering events. Minimal schema diff:
```
{ "event": "usage", "customer_id": "c-123", "tokens": 42, "customer_cap": 100000 }
```
Will update PR #482 with this.

ben-billing: I'll coordinate the ledger migration and backfill. Tentative migration slot Wed 02:15 UTC; will prepare a fallback if backfill stalls. Adding @eng-ops to schedule canary deploys.

ashley-eng: Canaries — suggested deploy command for eng-ops:
```
./deploy --service pricing-api --image pricing:v2 --canary 5%
```
Plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 30m observation windows.

ben-billing: pinging for code review on PR #482 from infra and billing leads. If reviews done Mon/Tue, we can merge Wed AM and run migration Wed 02:15.

carmen-legal: I'll circulate the addendum template and list of potentially impacted legacy customers. We need product to confirm the list by Tue 10:00 so legal can draft notices.

julia-pm: Thanks. Consolidating owners: Ashley (metering/ingest + PR #482), Ben (billing + migration), Carmen (contracts/addendum), Eng-ops (canary/deploy). Blocking items: PR #482 review, migration playbook, list of legacy customers for addendum. If we don't have blockers cleared by Tue 12:00 UTC, we delay the full rollout and run a limited canary only. Canary baseline: Wed 05:00 UTC (5%). Please update this thread with exact PR links and doc links. :eyes:

ashley-eng: Added PR link in #devex. Will call out tests and add `customer_cap` in the PR. :thumbsup:

ben-billing: I'll post the migration playbook in billing/docs and tag eng-ops. ETA for playbook: Tue 09:00 UTC.

carmen-legal: Addendum template posted to legal/share. Need product to confirm customer list ASAP.

julia-pm: Excellent — I'll send a short status email to stakeholders after Tue noon check. If anything pops up, ping here.
